title: Main Hall (Northshire)
wikitext:
[[File:Main Hall.jpg|thumb|300px|The Main Hall.]]

The '''Main Hall''' of [[Northshire Abbey]], located in [[Northshire Valley]] in [[Elwynn Forest]], serves as the entry of the abbey and grants access to the tower, [[Hall of Arms (Northshire)|Hall of Arms]], and [[Library Wing (Northshire)|Library Wing]]. This is also where young [[human]] [[adventurer]]s receive their first quests.
